meta.title: JPG to PNG Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert JPG images to lossless PNG format. Fast, free, and secure — no server needed.
formatAutoDetected: Format is auto-detected — no need to select manually
anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.
tooManyConversions: Too many conversions. Please wait a moment.
steps_jpg-to-png_1Desc: Select your JPEG image. PNG output supports transparency and lossless compression, making it ideal for logos, screenshots, and graphics with text.
steps_jpg-to-png_2Desc: PNG uses lossless compression, so no quality setting is needed. Your image will retain all visual detail from the original JPEG at the cost of a larger file size.
steps_jpg-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to transform your JPG into a PNG. The result downloads immediately — your original file is never modified.
desc: Convert JPG images to lossless PNG format. Fast, free, and secure — no server needed.
